description: Agent Legal: submit one amendment with the agreement it amends: the amendment with its reference, the agreement it identifies by reference and date, each party, and each change with its id, the clause it cites, its kind (increase, decrease, set, extend, shorten, replace, delete or add), how much it moves the figure or date and in which unit (amount, percent, days, months or years), the figure or date a set change gives, the figure or date it restates and its wording; the agreement with its reference, date, each party and each clause with its number, heading and any figure or date it states. The signed report gives the amendment and the agreement, the agreement identified against the agreement supplied, the parties both ways, each change paired with the clause it cites, and for each restated figure or date the figure or date the change gives from the clause, and counts them, and names a divergent amendment: one that identifies another agreement or names a party the agreement does not, a clause it cites that the agreement does not hold and a restated figure or date that does not follow from the change it makes; then a party to the agreement the amendment leaves out and an added clause numbered like one the agreement already holds, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A restated figure or date with no clause figure or date, amount or set value to read it from, an amendment that identifies no agreement or names no parties where the agreement does, no change, or an agreement with no clauses leaves the amendment unverified. The reference reads by its letters and digits, clause numbers without their Section or Clause prefix with bracketed parts as dotted ones, figures move by the amount or percent stated and compare to the cent, and dates move by the days, months or years stated, months to the same calendar day. This reads one amendment instrument against the agreement it amends: wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one terms or contract text clause by clause and returns what was added, removed or changed, while the amendment check compares no versions, reads the amendment as its own document against the agreement it identifies, and checks the clauses it cites and the figures and dates it restates. Verdict legal_amendment_divergent, legal_amendment_partial, legal_amendment_unverified or legal_amendment_consistent. POST /api/legal-amendment-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.

clauses.description: Each clause of the agreement, with any figure or date it states.

date.description: The date the clause states, such as the end of the term, when it states one, such as 2026-10-15.

figure.description: The figure the clause states, such as a fee or a cap, when it states one.

dated.description: The date of the agreement, such as 2026-10-15.

ref.description: The document’s own reference, such as MSA-2026-014.

amends_dated.description: The date of the agreement the amendment identifies, such as 2026-10-15.

amends_ref.description: The agreement the amendment identifies, by its reference.

by.description: How much the change moves the figure or date, in the unit stated.

clause.description: The clause the change cites, such as 4.2 or Section 4.2.

kind.description: increase, decrease, set, extend, shorten, replace, delete or add.

restated_date.description: The date the amendment restates after the change, such as 2026-10-15.

restated_figure.description: The figure the amendment restates after the change.

to_date.description: The date a set change gives, such as 2026-10-15.

to_figure.description: The figure a set change gives.

unit.description: amount or percent for a figure; days, months or years for a date.

wording.description: The change as the amendment words it.

ref.description: The document’s own reference, such as MSA-2026-014.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_legal-amendment-check
title: Legal amendment check
